app.title: Click Assistant
language.label: Language
language.tooltip: Choose the user interface language. The change takes effect immediately.
language.restartNote: The language will change the next time you start the application.
theme.tooltip: Choose the app's color theme: Auto follows your system setting, or pin Light/Dark.
profiles.new.tooltip: Creates a new, empty profile with default settings.
profiles.delete.tooltip: Permanently deletes the currently selected profile from the list and from disk.
toolbar.save.tooltip: Saves the current editor settings as a profile on disk.
toolbar.start.tooltip: Starts the click sequence for the current profile. Requires a Stop hotkey to be set.
toolbar.stop.tooltip: Immediately stops the running click sequence. Only active while a sequence is running - starting one requires both a Start and a Stop hotkey to be bound.
editor.name.tooltip: The name this profile is saved under and shown as in the list on the left.
editor.order.label: Order:
editor.order.tooltip: Controls the order points are clicked in: sequentially, in a manually set custom order, or randomly.
editor.repeat.label: Repeat:
editor.repeat.tooltip: How many times the whole point sequence repeats: once, a fixed number of cycles, or forever.
editor.interval.label: Interval (ms):
editor.interval.tooltip: The base wait time in milliseconds between clicking one point and moving to the next.
editor.jitter.label: Jitter (± ms):
editor.jitter.tooltip: A random deviation added to the interval so the app doesn't click at the exact same rhythm every time.
editor.addPoint.tooltip: Starts capturing a new point - click anywhere on the screen and the app will remember that position.
editor.capturingPoint.hint: Click anywhere on the screen to capture a point…
editor.addKeyStep.tooltip: Adds a step that presses a chosen keyboard key during the sequence instead of clicking the mouse. Screen coordinates aren't used for this step.
hotkey.start.label: Global Start hotkey:
hotkey.start.tooltip: A keyboard shortcut that starts clicking from anywhere in the system, even without the app window focused.
hotkey.stop.label: Global Stop hotkey (required):
hotkey.stop.tooltip: A keyboard shortcut that immediately stops clicking. It must be set, otherwise the app won't allow Start.
humanization.header.tooltip: A set of options that make mouse movement and clicking less robotically regular and harder to recognize as automation.
humanization.enabled.tooltip: Enables random offset of the click point and, optionally, curved cursor movement instead of an exact instant jump.
humanization.positionJitter.label: Position jitter (px):
humanization.positionJitter.tooltip: The radius in pixels by which the actual click point is randomly offset from the defined position.
humanization.curvedMovement.tooltip: The cursor doesn't jump instantly between points, but moves along a smooth curved path like a human hand.
humanization.durationMin.label: Movement min (ms):
humanization.durationMin.tooltip: The shortest possible duration of cursor movement between two points.
humanization.durationMax.label: Movement max (ms):
humanization.durationMax.tooltip: The longest possible duration of cursor movement between two points.
humanization.curveBow.label: Curve bow (%):
humanization.curveBow.tooltip: Maximum arc bend for the cursor path. Each click picks a random bow strength between 0 and this value, so movements vary instead of always curving by the same amount.
humanization.overshoot.label: Overshoot chance (%):
humanization.overshoot.tooltip: The probability that the cursor slightly overshoots the target and then corrects back, like a human sometimes does.
map.showScreenshot.tooltip: Shows a real zoomed-in screenshot of the area around the selected point next to the map, so you can see exactly where the app will click.
map.detailPlaceholder: Select a point on the map or timeline
map.monitor.focus.tooltip: Click a monitor to zoom in on it. Click again to show all monitors.
map.identify.tooltip: Briefly shows a large number over each monitor in the map, so you can tell which rectangle matches which physical monitor.
step.select.tooltip: Selects this step - shows its detailed preview and lets you edit it.
step.name.tooltip: A custom name for this point to help you navigate the sequence.
step.x.label: X:
step.y.label: Y:
step.xy.tooltip: The point's screen coordinates in pixels (X = horizontal, Y = vertical from the top-left corner).
step.actionType.label: Action:
step.actionType.tooltip: What the app does for this step: click the mouse at the coordinates, press a keyboard key without moving the cursor, or move the cursor to the coordinates and press a key there (useful for hover-dependent UI).
step.button.label: Button:
step.key.label: Key:
step.clickCount.label: Repeat count:
step.clickCount.tooltip: How many times the app clicks / presses the key for this step before moving to the next one.
step.customDelay.tooltip: Overrides the global interval for just this point - after clicking it, the app waits the given time instead of the default interval.
step.moveUp.tooltip: Moves this step one position up in the order.
step.moveDown.tooltip: Moves this step one position down in the order.
step.remove.tooltip: Removes this point from the sequence.
resolutionDialog.title: Screen resolution changed
resolutionDialog.message: The screen resolution has changed since the points were defined. Points may no longer target the correct location.
resolutionDialog.detail: Saved state: {0} monitor(s). Current state: {1} monitor(s).
